summary.text: Tara Peters is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 122 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A real estate agent who lives in Rolla, she is vice chair of the Children and Families Committee and of the Emerging Issues Committee.

paragraphs.text: Peters was born in Valparaiso, Indiana, lives in Rolla, Missouri, and earned a bachelor's degree in communications from Purdue University-Calumet.
Her career experience includes working as a real estate agent with Realty Executives - Ferrell Associates and owning and operating Pete's Pumpkin Patch.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was vice chair of the Children and Families Committee and of the Emerging Issues Committee, and was also assigned to the Commerce Committee and the Joint Committee on the Life Sciences.
